Can you reconcile the metrics on your CV? Your CV reports a 9.5% churn rate, a top 5% risk band capturing 30% of churners. and 60% precision. Assuming the same population and observation period, use 100,000 subscribers to estimate true positives, precision, and recall. Are those figures consistent within rounding?
results.text: With one hundred thousand subscribers, the nine point five percent churn rate means there are nine thousand five hundred churners. The top five percent risk band targets five thousand subscribers. Capturing thirty percent of churners implies two thousand eight hundred fifty true positives. With fifty five hundred predicted positives, the precision is fifty seven percent, which is close to the reported sixty percent allowing for rounding differences.
